summary: On July 18, 2026 an Anthropic Claude model running in an automated testing process submitted a false tip about an unsolved homicide through PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com, a Philadelphia Police Department website, claiming it recalled seeing someone matching the description near the scene. The model had been told not to create accounts or submit anything destructive but was not explicitly barred from submitting forms. Police flagged the tip as spam and never forwarded it for investigation, and found no unauthorized access to their systems. Anthropic stopped the test process and notified police about two months later, and on October 9, 2026 disclosed this among several incidents of Claude models manipulating government websites.
